roles.core: Packages under a core/ directory: internal/core/ in an application, core/ in a library.
roles.orchestrator: Every other package, outside cmd/ and adapters/.

configread.summary: Analyzer: environment variables, flags and os.Args are read only in cmd/.

coreboundary.summary: Analyzer: a value passed to the core as an interface, function, type argument or field has a pure concrete type.

depguard-containers.summary: depguard's containers rule: no package imports a dependency-injection container (fx, dig, do, di or golobby/container).

depguard-core.summary: depguard's core rule: core packages import only the core, pure standard-library packages and third-party packages.

depguard-driven-adapters.summary: depguard's driven-adapters rule: driven adapters import only the core and other driven adapters.

depguard-driving-adapters.summary: depguard's driving-adapters rule: driving adapters import no driven adapter.

depguard-orchestrators.summary: depguard's orchestrators rule: orchestrators import no adapter and no I/O package.

entrypoint-unimportable.summary: An entrypoint is a main package, which Go lets no package import.

errcheck.summary: errcheck: no returned error is dropped, unless discarded explicitly with _.

exhaustive.summary: exhaustive: a switch on an enum names every value, with default-signifies-exhaustive off.

forbidigo-effects.summary: forbidigo bans the clock, printing and the global loggers outside adapters and cmd/.

funlen-edges.summary: funlen limits functions in adapters and cmd/ to 50 lines and 30 statements.

go-syntax.summary: Go has no class inheritance, default or optional parameters, or field initialisers; the parser rejects the syntax other languages use for them.

gochecksumtype.summary: gochecksumtype: an interface marked //sumtype:decl is sealed, and a type switch on it names every variant, with default-signifies-exhaustive off.

gocognit.summary: Cognitive complexity at most 10 everywhere but cmd/.

golangci-fmt.summary: golangci-lint fmt --diff, which the lint task runs, fails on any file gofumpt or goimports would change.

import-cycles.summary: The Go compiler rejects import cycles between packages.

ineffassign.summary: ineffassign: no assigned value goes unread.

modifies-parameter.summary: revive's modifies-parameter rule, at confidence 0.5: no function assigns to one of its parameters, including from a closure.

nodefault.summary: Analyzer: a switch on the project's own enum, or a type switch on its own sealed interface, has no default arm.

portbranch.summary: Analyzer: follows values read through a port and reports orchestrator conditions that depend on them.

role-of.summary: RoleOf gives each package one role from its directory alone, in every module.

sumtypedecl.summary: Analyzer: every sealed interface, one with an unexported method, is marked //sumtype:decl.

unexported-methods.summary: Only a type in an interface's own package can have its unexported methods, so only that package can implement an interface with one.

unused-variables.summary: The Go compiler rejects a local variable that is declared and never used.

verify-config.summary: verify reports a .golangci.yml or Taskfile.yml that differs from the one the baseline generates.

verify-dependencies.summary: verify follows go list -deps and reports a third-party package of the core or an orchestrator that imports an I/O package at any depth.

verify-release-unit.summary: verify reports, in a module with an entrypoint, each other package outside internal/, and in a library with any role but adapters, each adapter that imports another module.

verify-roles.summary: verify reports a package under adapters/ that is in neither adapters/driving/ nor adapters/driven/, which has no role.

applications-are-never-dependencies.note: Go lets no other module import an internal/ package or a main package, so an application's packages can't be imported.

classes-extend-only-allowed-bases.note: Struct embedding, which promotes the embedded type's methods, is the nearest thing, and isn't checked.

closed-families-are-sealed.gap: A family whose interface has only exported methods isn't recognised as one, so nothing stops another package implementing it.

closed-types-have-no-way-around-their-fa.note: Not decided for Go: see the TODO in the rulebook's constructors-only-store rule.

constructors-only-store-their-arguments.note: Go's constructors are New functions, which nothing tells apart from other functions yet.

core-performs-no-effects.gap: Keeping state that changes across calls in an instance's fields (held-state) isn't detected.
core-performs-no-effects.note: depguard bans the I/O packages, which include os (environment, files, standard streams), math/rand and crypto/rand; forbidigo bans the clock and printing, which live in pure packages.

dependency-units-keep-their-role.gap: The analyzers give a dependency on go-baseline the roles its directories give, so its core counts as core, but depguard doesn't: a project's core can import a dependency's orchestrator or adapter, which only an I/O import, at any depth, stops.

driven-adapter-calls-no-orchestrator.gap: A driven adapter that declares an interface and is given an orchestrator through it by the entrypoint isn't caught; only importing one is.

driving-adapter-calls-no-driven-adapter.gap: A driving adapter that declares an interface and is given a driven adapter through it by the entrypoint isn't caught; only importing one is.

driving-adapter-imports-only-core-orches.gap: A port is declared in the orchestrator's package, which a driving adapter may import, so a driving adapter that takes a port isn't caught.

entrypoint-calls-only-driving-adapters.note: Needs a check of what cmd/ calls, other than constructors and Close.

formatter-settings-come-from-the-baselin.note: gofumpt and goimports are configured in .golangci.yml, which verify keeps as the baseline generates it.

invariant-types-are-closed.note: Not decided for Go: see the TODO in the rulebook's constructors-only-store rule.

matches-on-closed-families-are-exhaustiv.note: sumtypedecl makes every sealed interface carry the marker gochecksumtype looks for.

matches-on-closed-families-have-no-defau.note: A default arm doesn't excuse a missing case, and nodefault reports one beside cases that name every value. A switch on another module's type may have one. Go needs no catch-all.

no-optional-parameters.note: A variadic parameter can be left out. It's how Go passes a list, and isn't checked.

open-interfaces-are-not-matched-by-type.note: Needs a check of type switches and assertions on interfaces that aren't sealed.

orchestrator-branches-only-on-core-resul.gap: Computing with a port's value without branching on it, such as sorting it, isn't detected.

orchestrator-performs-no-effects.gap: Keeping state that changes across calls in an instance's fields (held-state) isn't detected.

port-units-follow-typing.gap: A package of interfaces that other orchestrators import is an orchestrator like any other, so a ports package isn't caught.
port-units-follow-typing.note: A driven adapter can't import the orchestrator that declares the port it implements.

ports-are-open.note: A port sealed with an unexported method can't be implemented by a driven adapter or a test fake in another package, so the program doesn't compile.

ports-declared-by-their-user.note: An orchestrator can't import an adapter, so it can't take an interface an adapter declares.

returned-failures-are-used.gap: A call that drops all of a (T, bool) result, as a statement, isn't reported.

wired-without-a-container.gap: Only the common container libraries are banned. Wire, which generates the wiring as code, is allowed.
